<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/console/pull/16501):

>**Analysis / Root cause**:
>
>Prow's Spyglass JUnit lens detects flaky tests by finding duplicate `<testcase>` entries with the same name — one with `<failure>` and one without. Playwright's built-in JUnit reporter uses `<flakyFailure>` elements (via the `includeRetries` option) which Prow's parser ([testgrid/metadata/junit](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/test-infra/prow/spyglass/lenses/junit)) silently ignores. This means tests that fail on the first attempt but pass on retry appear as simply "passed" in Prow's JUnit section, hiding flakiness from the team.
>
>Additionally, the Playwright HTML report is uploaded to GCS artifacts but not linked from the build log, and the `dot` console reporter provides minimal CI output.
>
>Jira: https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CONSOLE-5306
>
>**Solution description**:
>
>1. **Custom Prow JUnit reporter** (`e2e/reporters/prow-junit-reporter.ts`): Generates JUnit XML with duplicate `<testcase>` entries for flaky tests — one with the failure from the failed attempt, one clean from the passed retry — so Prow's deduplication logic correctly classifies them in a separate "Flaky" section.
>
>2. **Test summary in build log**: The reporter prints a summary at the end of the test run showing total/passed/failed/flaky/skipped counts and lists flaky and failed test names.
>
>3. **HTML report URL**: When running in Prow CI, the reporter constructs and prints the GCS URL to the Playwright HTML report using Prow environment variables (`BUILD_ID`, `JOB_NAME`, `PULL_NUMBER`, etc.).
>
>4. **Console reporter upgrade**: Switched from `dot` to `line` reporter for better CI log readability (shows test names as they run).
>
>5. **`includeRetries: true`** on the standard JUnit reporter: Adds `<flakyFailure>` elements for non-Prow JUnit consumers.
>
>6. **Artifact copy logic**: The Prow-compatible JUnit file is now copied as the primary `junit-playwright.xml` artifact, with the standard JUnit file kept as `junit-playwright-standard.xml`.
>
>**Screenshots / screen recording**:
>
><!-- TODO: Add screenshots of the Prow JUnit section showing the Flaky category after a CI run -->
>
>**Test setup:**
>
>No special setup required. The reporter runs automatically as part of the Playwright CI configuration.
>
>**Test cases:**
>
>- Verify flaky tests (pass on retry) appear in Prow's JUnit "Flaky" section instead of being hidden in "Passed"
>- Verify permanently failed tests still appear in the "Failed" section with error details
>- Verify skipped tests appear in the "Skipped" section
>- Verify the build log shows the test summary with counts and test names
>- Verify the HTML report URL is printed in the build log during CI runs
>
>**Browser conformance**:
>
>N/A — CI infrastructure change, no UI changes.
>
>**Additional info:**
>
>The Prow Spyglass JUnit lens [classifies flaky tests](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/prow/blob/main/pkg/spyglass/lenses/junit/lens.go) by grouping `<testcase>` entries by name. When it sees the same test name with both a failed and a passed entry, it sets `flaky = true`. The order matters for the state machine — failed entry first, then passed.
>
>**Reviewers and assignees:**
>
>/assign @snardowork
>/cc @spadgett
>

## Walkthrough This PR adds a custom Playwright reporter that generates Prow-compatible JUnit XML with aggregated test statistics, flaky test detection, and CI-friendly summaries. The reporter is integrated into the Playwright config and artifact collection scripts to emit separate JUnit outputs alongside standard reports. ## Changes **Prow JUnit Reporter** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Reporter types and utility functions**
`frontend/e2e/reporters/prow-junit-reporter.ts` (lines 1–116)|Defines reporter options, XML data models, utilities for ANSI stripping and XML escaping, XML serialization, error classification by message parsing, and helpers for test name and HTML report URL derivation.| |**ProwJUnitReporter lifecycle and test builders**
`frontend/e2e/reporters/prow-junit-reporter.ts` (lines 117–382)|Implements the `ProwJUnitReporter` class with `onBegin`/`onEnd` lifecycle hooks, test suite iteration, outcome classification (passed/failed/skipped/flaky), individual testcase entry builders with sanitized messages and stack traces, console summary with test counts and flaky list, and module export.| |**Playwright reporter configuration**
`frontend/playwright.config.ts` (lines 56–70)|Updates CI reporter list to add `line` reporter, expand `junit` with `includeRetries: true`, register custom `prow-junit-reporter`, and remove `dot` reporter.| |**Test artifact handling**
